annotation: The participant pursed their lips, extended both arms forward and out with the palms facing downward and fingers spread wide, then brought their hands up to smooth their hair while tilting their head back slightly.
The participant gave a slight shrug with their head bowing and hands clasped behind their back.
The participant laughed while tilting their head back slightly, brought their right hand up to stroke their hair, then covered their mouth.
The participant stuck their tongue out to the right, looked down, and clasped their hands behind their back.
The participant covered their mouth with their left hand, held their right hand behind their back, and looked down.
